objective: Close reviewed All in Code governance gaps without changing robot control behavior.
in_scope: Separate clean baseline checks from bounded candidate acceptance.
Bind actual unit outcomes and workflow test IDs to execution evidence.
Select the candidate design and its unit evidence from the ChangeContract.
Require complete review and evidence in one final repository-side gate.
Document the separately authorized GitHub rule rollout and current limitations.
out_of_scope: Merge, release, or GitHub settings writes without separate authorization.
Physical output, real hardware, and vehicle testing.
New navigation, localization, drivers, or multi-Agent orchestration.
invariants: The existing SafetyGate and physical-output boundary remain unchanged.
A baseline result cannot satisfy candidate acceptance.
A skipped, missing, failed, stale, or wrong-project required test cannot pass.
A candidate-authored JSON value cannot grant human approval.
stop_conditions: The candidate scope, test policy, design selection, or evidence relationship cannot be verified.
Any change would weaken stop behavior or enable physical actuation.
The required offline or Jazzy regression cannot run; report BLOCKED rather than PASS.
